name: typeof-over-literal-expression-test-2703e4397a/typeof-over-literal-expression-e.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: lists supported expressions but does not include typeof expressions or table constructors
## Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString
### Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: value:cloneWithType, value:fromJsonWithType, value:toString and value:toBalString
reason: Essential typeof expressions and table constructors are not covered by the positive expression list. The case additionally calls ensureType and isReadOnly, which are absent from the restricted lang.value API and method-call lists, so supported cloneWithType calls do not make the whole case in scope.
test_design_notes: Mixed scope: cloneWithType is explicitly supported, while ensureType and isReadOnly are not listed.
The @error markers occur on isReadOnly calls in functions named *Warnings; intended diagnostic severity is unclear. No @args, @panic or @output markers appear.
